links.outcome: ICD-10 and ICD-O code prediction accuracy (exact and partial match)
links.effect: RAG improved base LLM performance; with Llama 3.3 70B, partial-match accuracy was 80.6% for ICD-10 and 75.0% for ICD-O. The abstract gives no base-LLM figures.
links.tradeoff: The abstract says the additional effort of RAG needs to be justified, but it reports no cost or latency figures.
links.quote: RAG improved base LLM performance and outperformed embedding-based approaches on partial-match accuracy (80.6% partial-match accuracy for ICD-10 and 75.0% for ICD-O with Llama 3.3 70B), but not on exact-match accuracy.

design_hint: retrieval grounding (RAG) added to LLM for ICD coding
